function o54_seo_noindex() {
	return array( 1830, 1829, 1828, 1827, 1826, 1825, 1824, 1823, 1822, 1821, 1820, 1819, 1816, 1727, 1726, 3, 1818, 1817, 1734, 1696, 1623, 964, 962, 826, 946, 266, 110 );
}

add_filter( 'pre_get_document_title', function ( $title ) {
	$m  = o54_seo_meta();
	$id = is_page() ? get_queried_object_id() : 0;
	return isset( $m[ $id ] ) ? $m[ $id ][0] : $title;
}, 20 );

	// Search Console ownership (property https://www.office54.de/, added 07.10 under Egor's account)

}, 1 );

add_filter( 'wp_robots', function ( $robots ) {
	// is_home() too: /blog/ (110) is the posts page, where is_page() is false
	if ( ( is_page() || is_home() ) && in_array( get_queried_object_id(), o54_seo_noindex(), true ) ) {
		$robots['noindex'] = true;
		$robots['follow']  = true;
		unset( $robots['max-image-preview'] );
	}
	return $robots;
} );

add_filter( 'wp_sitemaps_posts_query_args', function ( $args, $post_type ) {
	if ( 'page' === $post_type ) {
		$args['post__not_in'] = array_merge( isset( $args['post__not_in'] ) ? (array) $args['post__not_in'] : array(), o54_seo_noindex() );
	}
	return $args;
}, 10, 2 );
